meta.source: Logo artwork exported from the Figma file "Build 2 Play" (gold #B39A72, black confirmed by Ziga); remaining neutrals derived.

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Brand gold, exact value from the logo artwork. The '2' in the mark and wordmark. 7.6:1 on black: fine for text on dark grounds. Fails as text on bone (2.2:1) and white (2.7:1): use gold-700 there.

tokens.name: gold-700
tokens.usage: Darkened gold for text and thin strokes on light grounds (4.6:1 on bone, 5.6:1 on white). Derived, not in the draft.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Brand black (confirmed). The ground behind every logo.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Brand white. Logo strokes and wordmark on black.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Warm off-white from the draft's light lock-up band. Light-theme ground.

tokens.name: gray-900
tokens.usage: Raised surface on black (cards, panels). Derived, not in the draft.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards and panels on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and logo strokes on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and taglines. ≥5.4:1 on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold for text, links and the '2' in either theme. Always passes 4.5:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between lock-up and tagline, card borders. Decorative only; not for control borders.

tokens.name: red-300
tokens.usage: Error red for text on dark grounds (9.0:1 on black, 8.0:1 on gray-900). Fails on bone and white: use red-700 there.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Error red for borders and icons on dark grounds (5.2:1 on black, 4.6:1 on gray-900).

tokens.name: red-700
tokens.usage: Error red for text, borders and icons on light grounds (5.4:1 on bone, 6.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error messages, error icons and destructive-action labels. Always paired with text, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border of an invalid input or an error alert. Meets 3:1 against surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Background of an error alert. danger text on it: 7.9:1 dark, 5.7:1 light.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headlines, set uppercase. One gold word at most (accent).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles. Uppercase or sentence case, consistently per surface.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase, widely tracked: eyebrows, nav, taglines outside the logo lock-up.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gaps between related items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups; logo-to-wordmark gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. The draft is square-cornered throughout.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and buttons, if a softer edge is wanted.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and chips only.
